questions.question: Mobile devices par responsive design ensure karne ke liye <head> mein kaunsa meta tag add karna zaroori hai?
questions.explanation: Viewport tag browser ko screen width ke hisab se layout adjust karne ka command deta hai.

questions.question: Google search results page par website title ke niche jo text snippet dikhta hai wo kis tag se define hota hai?
questions.explanation: <meta name='description'> search results mein preview description provide karta hai.

questions.question: Core Web Vitals metric LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) exactly kya measure karta hai?
options: Server se pehla byte aane ka time (TTFB)
Page ka largest hero content render hone ka time
questions.explanation: LCP screen ke sabse bade visual content block ke render hone ka duration calculate karta hai.

questions.question: Website par unexpected CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) aane ka sabse common reason kya hota hai?
options: Images par explicit width aur height na dena
questions.explanation: Bina dimension wali images load hote waqt content ko neeche push karti hain jisse layout shift hota hai.

questions.question: Chrome DevTools mein website ki Performance, SEO aur Accessibility ka comprehensive score kaunsa tool deta hai?
questions.explanation: Lighthouse tool automated audits run karke detailed scores aur improvements provide karta hai.

questions.question: Google Core Web Vitals ke hisab se ideal LCP time kitna hona chahiye?
questions.explanation: 2.5 seconds ke under LCP score ko Google 'Good' status classify karta hai.

questions.question: Image SEO aur screen readers ke liye element par kaunsa attribute mandatory hota hai?
questions.explanation: alt attribute alternative text describe karta hai jo SEO crawlers inspect karte hain.

questions.question: Core Web Vitals mein March 2024 se FID ki jagah kaun sa official interactivity metric introduce kiya gaya hai?
options: INP (Interaction to Next Paint) — Target threshold <= 200ms
TTFB (Time to First Byte) — Target threshold <= 500ms
questions.explanation: March 2024 mein Google ne FID ko replace karke INP ko official Core Web Vital banaya jo user interactions (clicks, taps, typing) ki responsiveness 200ms ke under expect karta hai.

questions.question: Social media sharing cards (WhatsApp, Twitter, LinkedIn) customize karne ke liye konse meta tags use hote hain?
questions.explanation: Open Graph protocol tags (og:image, og:title) link previews generate karte hain.

questions.question: Browser tab par website icon lagane ke liye standard syntax kya hai?
questions.explanation: <link rel='icon'> se browser tab par favicon render hota hai.
